concerns.text: Phase 0.3 specifies generating LLM code with the open‑source **StarCoder** model (`bigcode/starcoder` revision `2023-11-01`) on a CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM). Running a ~7 B‑parameter model for ~200 prompts (max_new_tokens = 1024) is unlikely to complete within the stated 6‑hour pipeline limit and may exceed the RAM budget, making the compute plan infeasible under the free‑model + free‑compute constraints of llmXive.
